title: Trigger and shim rules
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for three-tier trigger compilation with Role-Filler Frame isomorphism, conversation-aware submodular context-shim knapsacks, step-slicing HarnessTax break-even routing and privacy-safe compatibility matching.
boundaries: Quarantined or unverified provisions are blocked at Tier 3 before context injection.
Contributor-training memory entries are refused whenever workload data privacy is non-public.
Packed shim provisions obey strict integer token and character ceilings via exact dynamic programming.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for three-tier trigger compilation with Role-Filler Frame isomorphism, conversation-aware submodular context-shim knapsacks, step-slicing HarnessTax break-even routing and privacy-safe compatibility matching

value.lets_workers: Compile deterministic three-tier triggers with trigram bitmasks, anti-trigger vetoes and Role-Filler Frame isomorphism, deduplicate conversation provisions via versioned markers before solving a redundancy-penalized integer knapsack, compute step-slicing HarnessTax break-even rates across four intervention regimes and score memory or harness entries via Pareto compatibility matching.

flow.when: Filter candidate rules through trigram bitmasks, anti-trigger vetoes, Role-Filler Frame similarity and verified governance lenses.
Deduplicate versioned provision markers across conversation turns and solve a submodular 0/1 context knapsack.
Compute step-slicing HarnessTax break-even skip rates, route Shim/Code/LoRA regimes and rank privacy-safe Pareto winners.

value.worked_example: Synthetic 4-rule trigger, 4-provision conversation knapsack, 4-regime intervention router and 3-entry compatibility bundle recomputed in test_trigger_shim.py: routes a high-confidence status check to 0-token respond_directly and a frame-isomorphic 409 conflict to shim_context, vetoes exclude_keywords and quarantined candidates, packs 155 <= 180 tokens, computes 0.6 HarnessTax break-even skip rate and disqualifies contributor-training cloud memory on confidential data.

nouns.title: Guardrail: anti-trigger exclude_keywords veto at Tier 1 and quarantined provisions fail closed at Tier 3
nouns.category_reason: Prevents over-triggering on excluded contexts and blocks unreviewed or quarantined shims.

value.rule: Any rule matching exclude_keywords aborts at Tier 1, and any rule with governance_status quarantined or not verified aborts at Tier 3 when require_verified_governance is active.
value.how_it_is_checked: ThreeTierTriggerEngine.evaluate_rule returns matched false with tier1_exclude_veto or tier3_quarantined_governance.

nouns.title: Guardrail: memory or harness entries with contributor training enabled are refused on non-public workloads
nouns.category_reason: Prevents internal or confidential context from leaking into external provider training corpora.

value.rule: Whenever workload data_privacy_tier is internal or confidential, candidate entries with contributor_training_enabled true are disqualified before Pareto scoring.

slots.description: Pin of conversation history and candidate shim provisions.

steps: Parse [PROVISION: <id>@v<n>] markers across conversation history to skip already active provisions.

acceptance.check: ConversationDedupAndSubmodularKnapsack never exceeds token_budget or max_total_chars.
